finding_resolutions.scope_limit: Synthetic packet-validation checks do not establish processor qualification or P02-A03 acceptance.

finding_resolutions.finding: Original verifier required all eight generic checkout inputs to overlap the seven-input execution inventory and rejected unused checkout-only ci/blackbox.sh.

finding_resolutions.resolution: Require the exact eight trusted checkout paths, retain strict overlap equality and seven required execution inputs, allow only explicit checkout-only ci/blackbox.sh, and retain all eleven mandatory consumers.
